title: General Knowledge
author: TriviaMaker
description: A three-by-three starter board. Copy this file and replace the questions.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
What force keeps the planets in orbit around the Sun?
What is the name of the galaxy we live in?
What do you call a word that means the opposite of another?
How many letters are in the English alphabet?
What word describes a term that imitates a sound?
questions.note: Accept it read aloud; do not require the spelling.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a standard guitar have?
What Italian word means "gradually getting louder"?
